title: Safe Passage
description: Halvard has one wagon and this season's whole margin loaded onto it - bolts of dye bound for Thornfield, bought on credit he cannot repay if the wagon doesn't arrive. Bandits have already hit three caravans on this road this month. Vorn is putting a new Member on this because Halvard paid the Guild's asking price without haggling, and a merchant who doesn't haggle is a merchant worth keeping.

objectives.description: Meet Halvard at the Dalhurst gate, and the wagon he can't afford to lose
Keep Halvard's wagon moving toward Thornfield
Break the ambush before it takes the dye off Halvard's wagon
Get Halvard and his wagon into Thornfield

notes: Rank: Initiate -> Member (promotion). Escort quest with scripted ambush on Crossroads. Halvard must survive. Completion promotes player to Member rank. Threat: Halvard's whole season's margin is on the wagon, bought on credit; bandits have hit three caravans this month. Giver motive: Vorn rewards a client who paid without haggling by staffing the job properly. Consequence: losing the wagon ruins Halvard for the season - stated in prose, not wired since Halvard is scripted to survive.
